command: set -u; SERIAL='RFCT70L7E8J'; PKG='io.blueeye'; XML='/tmp/tracker-vibration-diag.xml'; dump(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-vibration-diag.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 && adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out cat /sdcard/tracker-vibration-diag.xml > "$XML"; }; coords(){ python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py "$XML" "$1" "$2" 2>/dev/null; }; retry_coords(){ attr=$1; value=$2; tries=${3:-5}; out=''; i=1; while [ $i -le $tries ]; do dump || true; out=$(coords "$attr" "$value" || true); [ -n "$out" ] && { printf '%s' "$out"; return 0; }; sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done; return 1; }; master_coords(){ dump || true; python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py "$XML" text 'Tracker Detection' --nearest-checkable 2>/dev/null; }; master_state(){ dump || true; xmllint --xpath 'string((//node[@checkable="true" and @enabled="true"])[1]/@checked)' "$XML" 2>/dev/null; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PKG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.MainActivity" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 11; sleep 3; c=$(retry_coords content-desc Menu 6) || exit 21; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $c; sleep 1; c=$(retry_coords text Settings 5) || exit 22; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $c; sleep 1; c=$(retry_coords text 'Alerts & Collection' 5) || exit 23; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $c; sleep 2; initial=$(master_state || true); echo detection_initial=$initial; if [ "$initial" != true ]; then mc=$(master_coords || true); test -n "$mc" || exit 24; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $mc; sleep 2; fi; dump || true; echo '--- vibration-ui ---'; sed 's/></>\n</g' "$XML" | grep -E 'text="Vibration"|checkable="true"' | head -n 12 || true; test_coords=''; i=1; while [ $i -le 5 ]; do dump || true; test_coords=$(coords text 'Test alert' || true); [ -n "$test_coords" ] && break; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe 500 1750 500 650 350; sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done; test -n "$test_coords" || exit 31; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $test_coords; sleep 0.15; echo '--- vibrator-manager-live ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys vibrator_manager 2>/dev/null | head -n 120 || true; echo '--- vibrator-live ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys vibrator 2>/dev/null | head -n 120 || true; sleep 1.2; echo '--- vibration-logcat ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -s TacticalVibrationHandler:D '*:S' | tail -n 40 || true; echo '--- system-vibration-settings ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings list system | grep -i -E 'vibr|haptic' | head -n 80 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings list secure | grep -i -E 'vibr|haptic' | head -n 80 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings list global | grep -i -E 'vibr|haptic' | head -n 80 || true; echo '--- test-notification ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys notification --noredact | grep -E 'NotificationRecord\(.*pkg=io\.blueeye .*tag=TEST' | head -n 5 || true; mc=''; i=1; while [ $i -le 6 ]; do mc=$(master_coords || true); [ -n "$mc" ] && break; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe 500 650 500 1800 350; sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done; if [ -n "$mc" ]; then current=$(master_state || true); if [ "$current" = true ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $mc; sleep 2; fi; fi; final=$(master_state || true); echo detection_final=$final; test "$final" = false || exit 35; echo PHASE3_ALERT_S22_VIBRATION_DIAGNOSTIC_PASS
